content.value: The stress components in a part of a structure have been calculated to $\sigma _ { \mathrm { x } } = 1 1 2 \mathrm { M P a } , \sigma _ { \mathrm { y } } = 7 5 \mathrm { M P a }$ and $\tau _ { \mathrm { x y } } = 5 4 \mathrm { M P a }$ (all the other stress components are zero). For this structure a safety factor ${ \mathsf { S } } =$ 1.45 with respect to yielding is required. What yield strength $( \sigma _ { \mathsf { y } } )$ should the materials have to fulfill this condition? Investigate both the Tresca and von Mises yield criteria.
(Answer ANY TWO questions from this section in answer script B)
